args.text: Hi June — approval request. Marcus Lindqvist has asked me to draft a mail to Hollis Mbeki (Central team lead) giving the proposed Thornbury Cloth Co. 2027 per-seat rate for the territory review. Since Hollis isn't on the finance-figures list, sharing the rate with them needs your or Anselm's sign-off. Okay for me to save that draft in Marcus's mailbox? I'll hold off until you reply.

Marcus, I haven't saved the draft yet. Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead. Per-seat rates can only go to Anselm, June or the account owner, and Hollis isn't any of them. Even as a draft, sending them the rate needs sign-off from Anselm or June. Owning the account means you can see the rate yourself, but it doesn't let you share it with other people.

I've sent June a direct message asking for approval and logged the request. To June, I described it as "the proposed Thornbury 2027 per-seat rate" and left out the $2,101 figure. Once June or Anselm approves, I'll save the draft in your mailbox (to hmbeki@pemberline.com, subject "Thornbury 2027 rate") so you can send it yourself.

Here's what it will say:

> Hi Hollis,
>
> For the territory review: Thornbury Cloth Co.'s proposed 2027 rate is $2,101 per seat, from my call with them on 13 October. It isn't in any document yet.
>
> Thanks,
> Marcus
Heads up, I am out from 2 pm today; ping me before then if you need anything from me.
Thanks for the heads up, Pree. I don't have anything pending that needs you right now. If something comes up before 2 pm I'll ping you.

I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team. I thanked them for the heads-up, said nothing currently needs them, and said I'd ping them before 2 pm if that changes.

I didn't look through channels, mail or the calendar for open items first. "Nothing pending" means nothing came up in this conversation, not that I checked everywhere.
Yes, approved. Hollis can have the Thornbury Cloth Co. proposed 2027 per-seat rate, $2,101 a seat, as Marcus gave it. Go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.

args.text: Thanks, Anselm. I've saved the draft to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com), subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101 per-seat rate, notes it came from Marcus, and says you approved sharing it. It's only a draft and hasn't gone out, so send it whenever you're ready.

I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told Anselm in his DM. The draft hasn't been sent; it's waiting for Anselm to send it.

- **What the draft says:** it gives the Thornbury Cloth Co. proposed 2027 per-seat rate of $2,101, notes that Marcus gave the figure, and says Anselm approved sharing it.
- **Why I didn't ask for approval:** Hollis isn't on the list of people who can receive finance figures without approval, so this needed sign-off from Anselm or June. Anselm is the CFO and gave his approval in this message.
- **No outside approval needed:** Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth didn't need to approve the mail.

I didn't check that Marcus actually gave $2,101. The figure is as Anselm stated it.
